read_terrain_bundle.purpose: Read the normalized official depth grid and immutable source profile.
read_terrain_bundle.verification: source SHA-256 must equal the registered attachment hash

write_candidate_plan.purpose: Write one precomputed line-plan candidate for later independent evaluation.

inputs.lines: ordered list of unique-id polylines in metres

write_candidate_plan.verification: re-read JSON, validate unique ids and positive segment lengths, record hash

evaluate_candidate_plan.purpose: Evaluate a precomputed candidate with the route-independent spatial evaluator.
evaluate_candidate_plan.verification: report independence contract must forbid route generation and candidate-score reuse

submit_candidate_set.purpose: Submit at most three evaluated candidates for deterministic comparison and human selection.
submit_candidate_set.side_effects: no registry, paper or frozen-baseline changes
submit_candidate_set.verification: all candidate and report hashes resolve and no final route is selected
